info.title: Starter API
info.description: Account sign-in and project management API.

post.summary: Create an account and start a session.
Join an organisation with an email invite.
post.description: The seven-day invite must match the email and works once. Creates an account and starts a session.

post.summary: Sign in and start a server session.
Set a new password with a single-use reset link.
Invite a person to your organisation.
post.description: Admins invite an email without an account. A new invite replaces its seven-day link. Production requires a mail provider.

post.summary: Create a project for your organisation.

get.summary: Download every project of your organisation as a CSV file.
Read one project in your organisation.

put.summary: Replace a project in your organisation.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a project in your organisation.

patch.description: Only admins can change another member of their own organisation.

get.summary: List your organisation’s members, oldest first.
Download every member of your organisation, oldest first.

200.description: The members.csv file: Email, Role and Joined (UTC).

get.description: Only admins can read change history. Changes are returned newest first.

get.summary: Download every change in your organisation.
get.description: Only admins can export change history. The file includes all changes, newest first.

200.description: The history.csv file: When (UTC), Who and What.

post.description: Logs the error kind and page path without error text or a query string.

get.summary: Check whether the API is ready.
